name: cognitive-playkit
description: Plataforma educativa para dislexia - Change Dyslexia Demo Project

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:workspaces && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: echo "Recuerda configurar la base de datos MySQL para la API"
scripts.dev: npm run check:requirements && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "API,LANDING,DASHBOARD,LETTER,WORD" --prefix-colors "red,cyan,yellow,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:landing" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:letter" "npm run dev:word"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "API,LANDING,DASHBOARD" --prefix-colors "red,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:landing" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:games
scripts.clean: npm run clean:deps && npm run clean:builds
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean:deps && npm run setup
scripts.check:requirements: node -e "console.log('Node:', process.version)" && php --version > /dev/null && echo "PHP disponible" || echo "PHP requerido"
scripts.ports: echo "PUERTOS: API http://localhost:8000 | Landing http://localhost:4321 | Dashboard http://localhost:4200 | Letter http://localhost:3001 | Word http://localhost:3002"
scripts.status: curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/metrics/dashboard > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "API funcionando" || echo "API no responde"
scripts.health: npm run check:requirements && npm run status
scripts.deploy:build: npm run build && echo "Build completado para deployment"
